session.name: locks_and_review
session.title: Locks stop the walk; human prose is flagged, never staled
session.summary: The same upstream edit, three times. Once normally: two beats stale. Once with beat 2 locked: the walk stops there and beat 3 is never reached, because a locked beat is not going to change. Once with human-written prose on beat 2: it is flagged for review rather than staled, the system does not tell an author their own sentences are out of date.
